messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Top-ranked tennis players (as of the most recent ATP/WTA rankings)**  

| Category | Current #1 | Notes |
|----------|------------|-------|
| **ATP (Men’s)** | **Novak Djokovic** | Djokovic has reclaimed the top spot after a brief dip in 2025. He’s been a dominant force on the tour for over a decade and remains the world’s highest‑ranked male player. |
| **WTA (Women’s)** | **Iga Świątek** | Świątek has held the No. 1 ranking for most of 2025 and 2026, cementing her place at the top of women’s tennis. |

> **Why this matters**  
> Rankings are updated every Monday by the ATP and WTA based on a player’s performance over the preceding 52 weeks. They determine seedings in tournaments, entry into events, and are a key indicator of a player’s current form.

If you’re looking for the *exact* ranking points or want to see the full leaderboard, you can check the official sites:

- [ATP Rankings](https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles)
- [WTA Rankings](https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings)

*(Note: Rankings can shift weekly, so the “current” top player may change after the next update.)*
